answer_1.quote: interactive machine translation (IMT) is a promising solution that can guarantee high-quality, error-free translations.

answer_2.quote: IMT-LAB introduces several end-to-end evaluation metrics for IMT systems... • Editing Cost (EC)... • Success Rate (SR)... • Consistency (Con.)... • Average Turns (AT)... • Response Time (RT)...

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, real users interact with different IMT models to finish the translation task and we build the website for this purpose.
answer_4.guideline: Translators use flexible operations (such as keep, insert, replace, delete, and blank-filling) to interact with IMT models without any requirements... the success rate is recorded as the unclicking rate of this [MTPE] checkbox...
